rows.grounds: E-23 cure verified from bytes. The driver label 'A quoted acclamation' is replaced, the absence arm ('the voice of rejoicing (v15a) itself carries no quotation mark') is struck, and strongest_rejected_alternative no longer rejects the rival on what the punctuation brackets but on the first-person distribution, so the test that killed the original passes; the order's two qualifications are met - all THREE v17 forms are named and 'communal' is now marked as the row's own reading rather than a byte fact. Installed claims re-derive at byte tier in their claimed positions: אָמ֥וּת, אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה and וַ֝אֲסַפֵּ֗ר stand in oshb:Ps.118.17, יִסְּרַ֣נִּי and נְתָנָֽנִי in oshb:Ps.118.18, and oshb:Ps.118.15 and oshb:Ps.118.16 carry no first-person form at all on their own bytes (ק֤וֹל רִנָּ֬ה וִֽישׁוּעָ֗ה בְּאָהֳלֵ֥י צַדִּיקִ֑ים יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל / יְמִ֣ין יְ֭הוָה רוֹמֵמָ֑ה יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל). The retained doubling digit re-derives on my own byte sweep: the four-token clause יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל returns exactly 2 verses book-wide (oshb:Ps.118.15, oshb:Ps.118.16), unit = verses, and it CLOSES each of them. BOTH SIDES of the rival seam web:Ps.118.16|web:Ps.118.17 from bytes: the preceding unit would close on that doubled clause, a refrain-type close, and the following would open on לֹֽא אָמ֥וּת (oshb:Ps.118.17), a return to the speaker's first person - both ruled classes, so the rival is live on bytes and the row's rejection of it now rests on the byte-grounded voice contrast, not on punctuation. The row's own edges hold: oshb:Ps.118.14 closes in the first person (וַֽיְהִי לִ֝֗י) before the unaddressed communal scene of oshb:Ps.118.15, and oshb:Ps.118.18 closes נְתָנָֽנִי before the second-plural imperative פִּתְחוּ opens oshb:Ps.118.19, coherent with M8-Ps-395 and M8-Ps-397; tiling exact (Ps.118.10-14 / 15-18 / 19-21), span, unit_type, confidence and parent unchanged. Psalm 118 is identity-numbered; no Selah and no K/Q in the span (pmarks_Ps.json). One low placement residue retained.

E-05 cure re-swept independently with the count object named: taking the verse's FIRST token at skeleton tier over verse_map_oshb.json, the demonstrative heads exactly oshb:Ps.118.20 and oshb:Ps.118.24 inside Psalm 118 (2 verses of 29), so the installed replacement - psalm-scoped, digit-bearing and unit-naming - is byte-true, while the shipped 'a book-wide sweep finds it only at 118:20 and 118:24' is false on that same sweep: the masculine form heads 6 verses book-wide (oshb:Ps.24.6, Ps.34.7, Ps.49.14, Ps.104.25, Ps.118.20, Ps.118.24) and the feminine form 4 (oshb:Ps.109.20, Ps.119.50, Ps.119.56, Ps.132.14), union 10 verses; even under the narrowest demonstrative-plus-article reading oshb:Ps.104.25 opens זֶ֤ה הַיָּ֥ם - the same shape as זֶֽה הַשַּׁ֥עַר and זֶה הַ֭יּוֹם - so the original was false under every reading and the replacement passes the test that killed it. Nothing over-tiered or speculative entered with the cure: the sentence is an anti-driver dampener, its conclusion (the device does not unite the triad) is unchanged, and its inference still holds on the new scope, since the two psalm-internal instances sit one on either side of this row's own opening seam (oshb:Ps.118.20 inside M8-Ps-397's span, oshb:Ps.118.24 inside this one). The row's other demonstrative facts re-derive at byte tier: זֹּ֑את stands at word index 3 of oshb:Ps.118.23 after מֵאֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הָ֣יְתָה (0-based indexing, the convention the neighbouring rows use), and oshb:Ps.118.22 carries no demonstrative at all (אֶ֭בֶן מָאֲס֣וּ הַבּוֹנִ֑ים הָ֝יְתָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ פִּנָּֽה). BOTH SIDES of the seam the changed sentence names, web:Ps.118.21|web:Ps.118.22, from bytes: oshb:Ps.118.21 closes on first-person thanksgiving addressed to Yahweh (א֭וֹדְךָ כִּ֣י ... עֲנִיתָ֑נִי וַתְּהִי לִ֝֗י) and oshb:Ps.118.22 opens on the impersonal third-person saying אֶ֭בֶן מָאֲס֣וּ הַבּוֹנִ֑ים, the ruled speaker/addressee class that decides it, so the correction moves no boundary; the rear seam is coherent with M8-Ps-399, whose span opens on the vocative plea אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה at oshb:Ps.118.25. Tiling exact (Ps.118.19-21 / 22-24 / 25-27); span, unit_type, confidence and parent unchanged; the row's open-referent uncertainty about the stone is still disclosed under the schema, not as an error. No finding.
